metadata.title: Export Logistics and Pallet Load Planning | YolPol
metadata.description: Plan pallet-based glass bottle export loads using verified packaging profiles.

ExportLogistics.heading: Export load planning
ExportLogistics.introduction: Plan a mixed pallet load from Products with verified packaging profiles.

capacity.heading: Truck capacity
capacity.text: The planning limit is 26 pallets and 26,000 kg gross weight. Exact limits are allowed.

method.heading: How calculation works
method.text: Enter whole pallets only. Packages, bottles and gross weight come from verified Product profiles.

calculator.heading: Pallet load calculator
calculator.disclaimer: This planning calculation uses verified pallet profiles. Final loading and vehicle suitability must be confirmed operationally; feasibility does not guarantee carrier, road, axle, customs or border acceptance.
calculator.insufficientData: Verified packaging data is unavailable for a selected Product.
calculator.arithmeticOverflow: The load is too large to calculate safely.

unavailable.heading: Products unavailable for calculation
unavailable.text: These Products lack a verified packaging profile, so no values are estimated.

steps.2: The truck arrives at the warehouse.
steps.3: The driver confirms the loaded cargo to the buyer.
steps.5: The truck is released only after settlement.
steps.6: International exit procedures are handled through the freight carrier.

limitations.heading: Important limitations
limitations.text: This is not carrier booking, a freight quotation, a legal transport document, a customs guarantee or a delivery promise.

ExportLogistics.listingFailure: Product packaging information is temporarily unavailable.
